The brown leather overcoat, dark inner lapels, white pointed shirt collar and one dark tie remain recognizable without obvious decoration duplication. The image-left three-quarter pose and gaze, chest crop, warm directional modeling and full pale cream/light-grey-beige backing are retained. The rounded chin sits directly above a short broad fitted collar without a long neck, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. No frame or note was invented. Full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows complete opaque backing and clothing without holes, smoke or a working-matte halo.
